description: 💋 Kiss your Touhou Little Maid! Adds affectionate interactions — heart particles, kiss sounds, and favorability boosts. NeoForge 1.21.1 addon.

mods.name: Touhou Maid: Affection
mods.description: Kiss your maid! Adds affectionate interactions to Touhou Little Maid.

releases.notes:
## 1.7.5.2 — 修复与整合包定制说明

- 修复随机礼物种类过少：新配置默认使用广泛物品池，模组物品每批重新抽样；黑名单仍优先。旧配置不强制改写，如仍只出现少量物品，请在「设置 → 功能 → 礼物准备」关闭「仅标签物品池」。
- 礼物准备结果持久化为队列，旧存档积攒份数保留；状态查询保持只读。降低队列上限不会删除已备礼物。
- 状态页新增女仆选择与礼物详情，按「随机礼物 / AI 早安吻」分组；可查看已备物品、准备进度与等待条件。
- 设置入口移到标题栏内的齿轮，避开其他模组页签；改善长文字及窄界面的适配。继续使用 Minecraft 默认字体与原有界面风格。
- 新增整合包作者教程，覆盖礼物标签数据包、配置、台词/语音定制，以及覆盖优先级、重载方式和当前限制。

### 作者教程 / Pack authoring

- [NeoForge 1.21.1](https://github.com/yabo083/Touhou-Maid-Affection/blob/v1.7.5.2/PACK_AUTHORING.md)
- [Forge 1.20.1](https://github.com/yabo083/Touhou-Maid-Affection/blob/v1.7.5.2-forge1.20.1/PACK_AUTHORING.md)

### English

Restores broad gift selection for new configurations, refreshes mod sampling per prepared batch, persists prepared gifts, and adds read-only per-maid gift status. Moves settings to an in-frame header gear and improves text fitting while retaining Minecraft's default font and the original UI style. Includes a source-checked pack-author guide.

Existing configurations are preserved. To restore broad selection in an upgraded instance, disable **Features → Gift preparation → Tag-only pool**. Install only the jar matching your Minecraft version and loader; replace the previous TMA jar rather than keeping both.

### MaidFileManager 可选联动 / Optional integration

若同时安装 MaidFileManager，需 **1.4.0+** 提供迁移 SPI，建议使用对应 Minecraft / 加载器的 [官方 1.4.2](https://github.com/zgxhzhr/MaidFileManager/releases/tag/v1.4.2-all)，并移除旧 JAR。1.3.1 不支持所需接口，会导致 TMA 初始化缺类。管理器本身不是 TMA 的必装依赖。

When MaidFileManager is installed, use **1.4.0 or newer**; 1.3.1 lacks the required migration SPI. The clearer dependency-version guard is committed for a future update, **not included in these 1.7.5.2 binaries**. See [issue #12](https://github.com/yabo083/Touhou-Maid-Affection/issues/12).
